address: 738 W Harris St, Meridian (Graycliff Estates; west of Meridian Rd along W Harris St)
owner_name: Predominantly Star Development Inc. (principal Allen Lee Centers) for the Graycliff Estates portion; adjacent unincorporated Ada County R1 farmland parcels along Harris St not publicly identified.
owner_type: developer / local homebuilder (Star Development Inc.); adjacent parcels likely farmer-family (county R1 ag land)
ownership_since: Star Development held the Graycliff land under a 2015 City development agreement (original 2015 plan of 134 homes), modified 2020; price not stated.
who_they_are: Star Development Inc. = Meridian residential developer/homebuilder (Allen Lee Centers), building 220+ contiguous acres between Meridian and Linder roads across three projects (Graycliff Estates, Biltmore Estates ~90 homes, Brundage Estates ~366 homes; ~870 units total).
intent_summary: Graycliff Estates (hearing Feb 6 2020; building since 2021) approved a preliminary plat of ~200 single-family homes (R-8) PLUS 224 apartments (R-40, high-density) and a neighborhood park on ~52 ac, via a modification of the 2015 DA. The multifamily component is the R-40 224-unit apartments. The rest of the 96.9-ac block is still unincorporated county R1 farmland with High-/Medium-Density Residential FLU — targeted for future annexation but no separate active application found.
project_status: Graycliff Estates: approved / under_construction. Adjacent county parcels: dormant.

address: S Locust Grove Rd, Meridian (Rescue Ranch; between E Amity Rd and E Lake Hazel Rd)
owner_name: Not publicly identified for the residential/ranch parcels. A ~37-ac 'Civic' portion at the north end (E Amity Rd near Hillsdale/Locust Grove) is owned by West Ada School District (reserved for a future middle school).
owner_type: farmer-family / rural large-lot landowners (Rescue Ranch) + institution (West Ada School District)
who_they_are: Rescue Ranch is an older rural/large-lot subdivision east of Locust Grove between Amity and Lake Hazel. West Ada School District (Idaho's largest) holds a ~37-ac reservation for a future middle school, no firm build date.
intent_summary: No active annexation/subdivision/apartment application identified on these specific parcels as of mid-2026. FLU is Civic + Medium-Density Residential (planned); current use agricultural/rural residential. The corridor is urbanizing (nearby Solara Estates, Brighton's Apex/Pinnacle, Summerlin West; ACHD Amity/Locust Grove roundabout), but SM-5 itself is dormant aside from the school reservation.

address: S Johnson Ln, Meridian (between I-84/Waltman Ln and W Overland Rd, west of Meridian Rd)
owner_name: Not definitively confirmed for the specific parcels. Corresponds to the Tanner Creek / Hawkins Companies assemblage near Meridian Rd & I-84 (Waltman Ln). Commercial portion associated with Hawkins Companies; residential (Tanner Creek) originally Schultz Development, now developed by CBH Homes.
owner_type: developer (Hawkins Companies – retail/commercial; CBH Homes – large local homebuilder; Schultz Development – original proposer)
ownership_since: Long history: Tanner Creek first proposed under Schultz Development (denied 2018), revived 2023; dates/prices not stated.
who_they_are: Hawkins Companies = Boise retail/commercial developer; CBH Homes = Idaho's largest homebuilder, now building Tanner Creek; Schultz Development = local developer that originally proposed the project.
intent_summary: Tanner Creek (joint hearing Nov 21 2023; moved forward) proposes 83 single-family homes + 45 townhomes + 280 apartments (phased) on ~37.9 ac, paired with a ~30-ac Hawkins commercial development between I-84 and Waltman Ln west of Meridian Rd. Zoning C-G/R-15/R-40 + Mixed-Use Community FLU match SM-15. Apartment occupancy tied to the Linder Rd overpass. Multifamily threat = 280 apartments. (Street name 'S Johnson Ln' inferred from zoning + geography.)
project_status: approved/under_construction residential (CBH building); commercial proposed/in progress

address: E Franklin Rd, Meridian (1475 E Franklin Rd; SW corner of E Franklin Rd & S Locust Grove Rd, R-40)
owner_name: Owner of record not named in the staff report. Applicant/developer is Realm Venture Group (Meridian OZ Apartments). The ~4.9-ac / 2-parcel block combines the 2.39-ac OZ apartment parcel + the adjacent parcel south; site was part of the 1999 Cobblestone Village annexation.
ownership_since: unknown; property annexed 1999 as part of Cobblestone Village (which had a 96-unit multifamily CUP then).
who_they_are: Realm Venture Group is an apartment development entity ('OZ' likely references a federal Opportunity Zone). LLC principals not confirmed via Idaho SOS in this research.
intent_summary: Meridian OZ Apartments (H-2022-0073, ~2022-23): a CUP for a 60-unit multifamily development (30 one-bed + 30 two-bed) at ~25 du/ac in R-40, plus a DA modification to remove the site from the 1999 Cobblestone Village DA. Sole access off Locust Grove. Meridian P&Z voiced concern that 25 du/ac exceeded the 6-15 du/ac anticipated for the MU-Community FLU; several leaned toward denial. Final Council outcome not confirmed; no evidence built as of 2026. Multifamily threat = 60 units.
